correctness.summary: After normalizing to zero-balanced hypergeometric functions, monotonicity in a reduces p>=2 to a=1/2. A sharp logarithmic-derivative lemma for B_{1/2}=arctanh(sqrt x)/sqrt x, transferred coefficientwise to b<=1/2, makes the Riccati residual strictly negative; a first-crossing argument proves the power bound.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Dou-Yin-Lin (2019) explicitly posed the weaker target inequality. Wang-Qi (2020) obtained exponent 1/2, whereas the present exponent (q+1)/(2q) is larger and implies the 2019 exponent for p,q>=2. Searches of the exact equation, equivalent hypergeometric form, source papers, and later generalized-elliptic literature found no prior coverage; differently phrased or poorly indexed coverage remains possible.

value.summary: The result closes a named 2019 open problem and strengthens the closest located 2020 lower bound over the full requested parameter range, using a reusable endpoint-parameter reduction plus Riccati comparison.

limitations: The exponent (q+1)/(2q) is not claimed optimal for fixed parameters.
The result is restricted to p,q>=2.
A substantially differently phrased or poorly indexed prior hypergeometric theorem may exist.
Independent audit has not been performed.
